Being struck by it doesn't hurt much, but the fourth swing in a string of attacks will send the victim flying.|Inventory|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 1 |durability = 80 |flammable = No |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Spring-Loaded Hammer}} The Spring-Loaded Hammer is a [[Hammer]] that can be obtained from [[Kilton]]'s [[Shop]], the [[Fang and Bone]], for 199 [[Mon]]. It can only be purchased after [[Link]] has freed at least one [[Divine Beast]] from [[Calamity Ganon]]'s control. When spoken to after doing so, Kilton will announce the development of the Spring-Loaded Hammer and describe its effects.{{Cite|Da da...DAAAAAAAA! I've developed a new piece of {{Color BotW|Blue|monster gear}}! I call it the... {{Big|{{Color BotW|Blue|Spring-loaded hammer}}!}} Whack a small monster with this thing, and...BOING! It'll launch the monster into the distance! It's really useful for getting rid of pesky monsters that you don't feel like fighting. Plus, it's just fun to use!|Kilton|BotW}} Unlike other Hammers in {{BotW}}, the Spring-Loaded Hammer is held with one hand. When the Spring-Loaded Hammer is used, the fourth hit from a chain of regular attacks will send certain [[Enemy|Enemies]] flying. As it has little strength, it is primarily meant for entertainment. The Spring-Loaded Hammer is not magnetic and cannot be retrieved with [[Magnesis]]. This also means that it will not attract [[Lightning]] during a [[Thunderstorm]], and it will not conduct [[Electricity]]. When dropped into [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], it will float on the surface. When exposed to an open flame, such as a [[Campfire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], it will catch [[Fire]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_040" |Life = 80 |Power = 1 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = true |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 1 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 1 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 9 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 17 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 2 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 2 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 18 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 41 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 2 |BuyingPrice = 15 }} ==Trivia== * An unused icon and description for Spring-Loaded Hammers exist within the files of {{AoC}}.{{Cite Internal|quote= This strange hammer is one of the specialties of the merchant from Skull Lake.
